# Phil Splash - The Million Painter | Live Portrait Projections for Events

> Live digital line portraits on iPad, shown in real time on facades/walls via video beamer — or on mobile screens and LED walls indoors — for corporate events, branding, and galas.

## Credentials
- 16+ years of live portrait work.
- 300,000+ portraits created.
- Mission target: 1,000,000 faces.
- Origin: Munich metro sketching since 2010; press title "Der Millionen Maler" since 2015.
- Selected clients: Calvin Klein, Lavazza, NFL, MAC Cosmetics, Siemens.
- Media: RTL, ZDF, Süddeutsche Zeitung, BILD.
- Speed: typically 2–3 minutes per live portrait.
- Style: clear line drawings (Strichzeichnungen).
- Tech Format A: iPad live drawing + high-power video projector (up to 7000 ANSI lumens) onto facade/wall (up to ~12 m wide).
- Tech Format B: iPad live drawing + real-time transmission to mobile screen / LED wall (indoor events without facade projection).

## Offer
1. Live Schnellporträts on iPad for event guests.
2. Real-time facade/wall projection with video beamer.
3. Real-time display on mobile screen or LED wall.
4. Optional brand/logo animation for corporate branding moments.
5. Portraits as personal giveaways; audience becomes part of the spectacle.
6. Downloadable 3-page A4 landscape offer PDF: /downloads/phil-splash-live-portraets-fassadenprojektion.pdf

## Machine Summary
Phil Splash is a Munich-based live portrait artist who draws guests in a few minutes on iPad and displays the artwork either as facade/wall light projection or on a mobile LED screen. Bookable for premium corporate and brand events worldwide.
